reviews.finding: Accept the same-slab route-pruning proposition only. Reject transfer to AB singular/ancient class because the witness is a regular initial-layer family with no first singular time or long backward history.

Uniformly small L3 data are compatible with exact global mild/strong NSE solutions. Fixed-N smooth-data classical trace continuity is sufficient to move the vorticity lower bound to t_N>0; no uniform derivative lifespan is claimed.
On a fixed-measure core, |omega(t_N)|>=cN implies weak-L3/2 norm >=c'N by the distribution-function definition. Pure Navier-Stokes scaling was correctly rejected as it preserves both critical norms.

A,C,D are uniformly bounded by global L3 and Calderon-Zygmund pressure control. The E estimate closes by the local energy cutoff with O(r M3^2+r M3^3) terms; no N-dependent derivative bound enters the producer ledger.

The result removes one universal producer edge but does not supply source-family completeness, ancient compactness, far-field tightness, backward uniqueness, or any Type-I/II rigidity theorem. Next route must add a history/state-space coordinate.
Vector-potential construction is exactly divergence-free, has uniform L3 size and O(N) curl on the chi=1 core. Positive-time trace avoids an initial-data-only falsifier.
